title: pm(half-states, pm-dispatch): four readers still say closed for a Blocked-by PR target that releases on merged (dispatch-runbook flag two, H28, the H4 mixed line, the scheduled run note)
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS

Filing gate ①: a follow-up owed by in-flight work. It comes from the contract review of PR #28031 (#27989), should-fixes 1, 2, 4 and 5; the review is on that PR. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (#19287). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** After PR #28031, the H4 prose half, the SKILL.md `pm:blocked` row and the platform reading all say that a `Blocked-by:` PR target releases on **merged**, while a closed-unmerged one releases nothing. Four places still say "closed" for a PR target. None of them changes a verdict, so this is wording only. But a seat reading them can mistake an abandoned PR for a released blocker.

**Reader who acts:** the pm-dispatch protocol and the half-state patrol owner.

## Measured (PR #28031 head `45763c74`, 2026-10-30)

1. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md:85` reads 「旗二:`pm:blocked` 卡的 `Blocked-by:` 目标已关闭。」 It is the one remaining skill-text reader that says closed for a target which, when a PR, flags on merged. The fix is one word in-line, on a governed path (Tier S, `.claude/**`, developed on fable per the project rule).
2. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` `h28StaleBodyBlockerLine` (about :7652 and :7659) counts an abandoned PR as "spent" and says CLOSED. This is card #27989 item 5, which was conditioned on touching H28; PR #28031 did not touch it. The verdict and the remedy are right. `namedTargets` already renders `closed UNMERGED`.
3. In `proseBlockerClause`, the mixed branch prints `0 still read OPEN, …` when the only rows are abandoned or unresolved. This is cosmetic; the counts and the verdict are right.
4. `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` `renderBlockNote` (about :661-663) renders a merged PR as `(closed …)`. It is reachable only after `staleBlockVerdict` has excluded unmerged rows, so it is true but imprecise.

## Wanted

- Items 1–4 as wording: merged for a PR target, closed for an issue.
- Edit the rule text in-line and keep the line count neutral. Pin the script wording only where a pin already reads that text.
- ⛔ No new gate. No verdict changes.
- Optional, if a line of headroom exists: a measured-leg line in `platform-readings.md` for `issue_read` on a PR number (state closed, no `pull_request`, no `merged_at`), styled like :228-:230 (review should-fix 3).

## Blocked-by

PR #28031 (the merged/abandoned buckets this wording follows).

Blocked-by: #28031

## Dedupe

Searched the newest 100 open issues for "dispatch-runbook 旗二", "h28StaleBodyBlockerLine" and "renderBlockNote": none.
